title: Implement Filter Preset object graph states
description: Render the first-slice Filter Preset architecture states from a single object graph.
objective: Implement frames 20, 19, 18, 17, 24, 23, 22, 21, 26, and 27 as states of one admin product system.
acceptance_criteria: All states read from one coherent object graph.
The inspector context matches the selected object/layer/module.
Inherited, override, feeds, owns, and controls relationships are visually meaningful.
Dense content does not cause page-level horizontal overflow.
verification: Open each state in WP admin.
Capture desktop screenshot for each implemented frame state.
Confirm console has no JS errors.

Implemented one FilterPresetGraph and state renderer for frames 20 19 18 17 24 23 22 21 26 and 27; all states are navigable through eit_state and read from the same admin object graph; PHP lint passed for AdminPages AdminPrimitives FilterPresetGraph and FilterPresetStates; WP CLI render smoke returned ok for all ten states; Playwright generated desktop and mobile evidence under docs/assets/implementation-toolkit/admin-v0.2/qa/TASK-006; desktop and mobile overflow checks passed after the frame 18 mobile fix; preview modal opens as Filter Controller Preview and includes the No listing grid marker; browser console returned 0 errors; root and plugin git diff check passed; no runtime filtering listing grid REST behavior CPT registration or new dependency was introduced

budgets.context_budget: primary frame docs and existing admin source only
budgets.iteration_budget: two visual QA loops per state group
budgets.validation_budget: visual QA evidence required before done

risks: This task can expand endlessly if every frame becomes a separate screen.
Object graph and saved option shape can drift apart.
